films.title: 25 and Under: An Introduction to Marilyn Monroe
films.description: An introduction to one of Hollywood’s most iconic stars.

films.title: All About Eve

films.description: Marilyn Monroe steals all of her scenes in this Hollywood classic about an ageing star unwittingly letting an aspiring actress into her life.

films.title: As Young as You Feel
films.cast: Monty Woolley, Thelma Ritter, Jean Peters, Marilyn Monroe
films.description: A man battles against mandatory retirement in this quirky film from Marilyn Monroe’s early career.

films.title: Babenco: Tell Me When I Die
films.description: A tender portrait of one of Brazil’s most influential filmmakers, Héctor Babenco.

films.title: Barbara
films.cast: Nina Hoss, Ronald Zehrfeld, Jasna Fritzi Bauer, Mark Waschke
films.description: Christian Petzold’s understated, thrilling drama sees a Berlin doctor forced to relocate to a country hospital in 1980s East Germany after a failed exit visa.

films.title: A Better Tomorrow
films.cast: Ti Lung, Leslie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat
films.description: This tale of two brothers on the opposite sides of the law marks the emergence of John Woo’s signature action filmmaking style.

films.title: Bus Stop
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, Arthur O’Connell
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is an unvarnished singer evading an overly keen cowboy in this romantic comedy-drama.

films.title: Bus Stop
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, Arthur O’Connell

films.title: Candy Mountain
films.cast: Kevin J O’Connor, Harris Yulin, Tom Waits, Joe Strummer
films.description: Scripted and co-directed by Rudy Wurlitzer (Two-Lane Blacktop), this quintessential road movie is a rarely screened gem.

films.title: Call Me by Your Name
films.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Armie Hammer, Michael Stuhlbarg
films.description: Written for the screen by James Ivory, this gorgeous coming-of-age drama about a young man experiencing first queer desire made Timothée Chalamet into a household name.

films.description: A lyrical road movie wherein cinema and friendship cross Brazil’s arid countryside.

films.description: Marilyn Monroe impresses as a naïve small-town girl in Fritz Lang’s dark melodrama fraught with sexual tension.

films.title: The Citizen
films.cast: Satindra Bhattacharya, Prabhadevi, Sova Sen, Ketaki Devi

films.cast: Helena Albergaria, Magali Biff, Rogério Brito

films.cast: Sônia Braga, José Wilker, Mauro Mendonça
films.description: Sonia Braga dazzles in this sensual and hugely popular classic.

films.description: An ordinary man’s conscience is ignited as apartheid’s violence shatters his complacency, in a searing drama about moral courage and the cost of looking away.

films.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
films.cast: Jane Russell, Marilyn Monroe

films.description: A young girl finds herself torn between duty and desire in this stunning Sri Lankan coming-of-age drama.

films.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Leslie Cheung

films.cast: Emmanuelle Riva, Eiji Okada
films.description: Alain Resnais’s masterpiece, one of the defining features of the French New Wave, is a powerful meditation on unspeakable memories and piercing desire.

films.description: In this hilarious comedy, Marilyn Monroe teams up with Betty Grable and Lauren Bacall as three women on a mission to marry wealthy suitors.

films.description: Pixar’s latest is a smart, witty and joyously inventive tale of a young girl who, through the advances of science, is able to communicate with animals.
